text: 6.12 Monitoring of NFE Performance of EOUs shall be monitored by Units Approval Committee as per guidelines given in Appendix 6F of Appendices & ANFs. Performance of EHTP / STP / BTP shall be monitored by Meit Y / Do BT jointly with jurisdictional Customs authority.
